intro.text: A member of the Elendel constabulary.

items.text: In 348 Kellen went with Marasi to Bilming for a sting operation. When they were drawn into a firefight, Marasi had him help organize a retreat, and he waited with Captain Blantach for her signal, but an enemy Allomancer Pushed away the trucks they were using for cover. How Kellen fared in the chaos is unknown.
